$Comment: Pieces of gear a Disenchanting Table took apart, rung 7 of the disenchanting_unmade ladder. STATION_INPUT counts a stack the moment a station consumes it; the blank Target matches every item, so any piece of gear counts and nothing else can reach a table. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts BOTH tables (the greater table's station id starts with the lesser's); a qualifier left out would count the same item at the Sawmill too, so every disenchanting count names it.
Name: Disenchanting_Unmade_T7
